verdict.rationale: WooCommerce's REST API supports generating scoped API keys per user with Read, Write, or Read/Write access levels, tied to the user's WordPress roles/capabilities, which provides some least-privilege control usable by an agent (woocommerce-docs-x1, woocommerce-docs-11, woocommerce-docs-27). However, this is coarse-grained (three access levels, not fine-grained per-resource/per-agent scoping) and there is no evidence of agent-specific credential issuance, expiring tokens, or scoped-per-task permissions purpose-built for AI agents. missing for 10: fine-grained per-resource or per-action scoping, ability to issue short-lived/revocable tokens specifically for agent use, documented best practices for least-privilege agent credentials, and independent confirmation of this working in agentic workflows.
